record_type: Numeric projection of original controlled CLI aggregate
mode: Real --yolo --autopilot; fixed synthetic prompt; no extra deny rules

method.rendering: Original request rendered through /apply-template and counted through /tokenize.
method.native_cross_check: Original analyzer rejects any mismatch against server usage.prompt_tokens.
method.work_count: Standalone native-tokenizer count of the uniquely identified synthetic work text.
method.non_work_cost: Full rendered prompt tokens minus standalone controlled work-text tokens.
method.tool_injection: Full rendering minus a rendering with tools, tool_choice and parallel_tool_calls removed.
method.limits: Component and individual marginal counts are not generally additive. This is one CLI configuration, not a universal fixed cost.
method.privacy: Paths, request/capture identities, section labels, schemas and all prompt/message bodies are omitted.

author_assertion.author: knandu
author_assertion.statement: this is the system prompt + tool description overhead
author_assertion.interpretation: Effective system/tool scaffolding for the tested CLI configuration, including associated framing and ancillary messages.

followup_validation: Offline arithmetic/provenance checks only; original captured input was not opened or replayed.
